trigger.description: The workspace already carries a materialized SRR6.46.3 peer group bound to one tailscale tailnetId, but the current SRR6.46.46.8 identity-change guard detects a different tailnet on the local Tailscale probe. Auto-enrollment refuses to overwrite the existing materialization onto a foreign tailnet; the operator must explicitly disable mesh before re-running on the new tailnet so the prior peer group is not silently rebound to keys that never belonged to it.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # populates peer group against tailnet-alpha
tailscale up --login-server <other-coordinator>   # or migrate to tailnet-beta
ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # this run trips the guard
